title: andinia ciliaris
intro: Andinia ciliaris, commonly known as Andina or Peruvian ginseng, is a species of flowering plant in the family Ericaceae. This plant has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fatigue and stress. The therapeutic actions of Andinia ciliaris include stimulating the immune system, improving mental clarity, and promoting overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Andinia ciliaris include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
